issues.description: StockIngredient constructor signature differs between artifacts: The problem statement's class diagram declares StockIngredient(String, int, int) (three parameters). The solution repository provides a three-argument constructor public StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity). The template repository only provides a four-argument constructor public StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity, boolean strictValidation). This mismatch will cause compilation errors for student code and the example usages that call new StockIngredient(name, price, quantity) and is likely to confuse or block students.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template API match the problem statement and solution by adding a three-argument constructor to the template: public StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity). Implement it to perform the same validation/initialization as intended (for example delegate to the existing strictValidation constructor or replicate its validation with sensible defaults). Alternatively, if the four-argument constructor was intentional, update the problem statement and example usages to document and use the four-argument signature. Prefer adding an overloaded 3-arg constructor to avoid breaking existing pedagogical examples.
